messages.text: Hi i left my review and try to send the email with picture. But replying to the email, (email hidden), will return with an error message.

Sorry about that bounce. You don't need email for this, just attach the picture here in the chat and it reaches us with this conversation.

What's in the photo, so I know what it's for?
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Pascal, that's a great review, thank you. Five stars and the BC04 set up easy on the HarloLabs pool, that's exactly what we like to hear. It shows as pending on Trustpilot, which is normal, it usually goes live within a day or two.

Nothing more needed from your side, the picture came through fine here. Enjoy stacking those bolts.
So the code for discount will arrive through email?
I can't promise a code myself, and I don't want to tell you one is coming if it isn't. Let me get that answered properly.
Handed to the team · Cannot confirm or issue a review-related discount code myself.

Passed to Georges. The team is offline right now and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.

Thanks again for the review, Pascal.

Happy to help, Pascal.

One thing I'm curious about, since nobody asked you to: what made you sit down and write that review?
Because this miner disserves the credit, and of course Helium Deploy for the quick delivery and opportunity to mine at home!

That means a lot, thanks Pascal.

One more, since you mentioned it: you had to find a setup video online. What was missing from what came in the box, so we can fix it for the next buyer?

And if you're not in there yet, our Discord is worth a look for pool tips and new gear: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
I set this miner up for the HarloLabs BCH Pool. I had lookup how to get it on that address. Also how to update to the latest software ofcourse.

Useful, thanks. Pool address and the firmware update are the two things people hunt for, so that's worth putting in the box.

Firmware and guides live at https://harlolabs.com if you ever need the newest build. Enjoy the BC04, Pascal.
Anytime, Pascal. Good luck with the bolts, and come back if anything comes up.
